title: Who Bears the Risk When Generative AI Enters Transport? A Distributional Sociotechnical Audit of Algorithmic Equity, Synthetic-Data Validity, and Public Trust
reasoning: The paper investigates algorithmic equity, demographic disparities, and social bias (concerning attributes such as race, gender, and age) in LLM-generated transport advice. It does not specifically focus on evaluating, benchmarking, or exploring religious texts, moral dilemmas, or theoretical ethical frameworks.
